objective: Jointly select maximum ETF count X and target-change rebalance threshold n by net Sharpe with existing return/drawdown guardrails.
secondary: Current F3 12-candidate pool, legacy activity basis; transfer the same selected calendar with all meaning all 12. No separate F3 optimization.
all_semantics: Maximum count equals the parent candidate-pool size. Eligibility, positive momentum gate, minimum-selection fallback, cash protection and downstream sizing remain unchanged. No forced allocation.
comparisons: Joint pairs versus current top-six monthly; same-width monthly controls distinguish width and timing effects. No new daily-full control is needed; the prior study retains it.
distance: Strict L1 latest theoretical target minus last logically adopted target, including cash; never actual holdings.
inputs: Reuse the previous study's verified pinned audited prices, causal parent models and operator-authorized exact-else-monthly macro policy. No new captures or provider price inputs.
funding: USD1000000 common start, whole adjusted units, zero cash interest, shares held between events.

selector.stress: Positive Sharpe uplift and the same CAGR/drawdown guards at 10bp/no delay and 5bp/one extra session.
selector.stability: At least one passing immediate Manhattan neighbor in the ordered X-by-n grid; monthly is the final n column. Report F3 all/12 duplication, never count it as independent confirmation.

walk_forward: Use 6/monthly through 2023. Apply each FR25-selected pair from the first monthly event in the validation year, carry shares/cash/adopted target, charge transition costs. F3 follows the same pair. No NAV splicing.
assessment: Same registered aggregate validation return/drawdown guards, Sharpe uplift >=0.05, positive Sharpe uplift in at least two of three folds, and aggregate 10bp/no-delay plus 5bp/extra-delay stress guards. F3 transfer is a legacy-basis sensitivity only.
size_diagnostic: USD100000 control, selected walk-forward and final fixed pair; no retuning.

inference.scope: 47 fixed non-control pairs plus walk-forward for each parent, joint common 2024-2026 resampling with URTH. Conditional descriptive intervals and Holm; no selection-aware formal superiority claim.

verification: Top-six daily targets and common fixed-pair economics reproduce the preceding study. Independent adoption checks; native LEAN parity for controls, selected walk-forward, final fixed pair when distinct, and a wider-X/0.10 eventful pair.
diagnostics: Membership entry/exit versus retained-asset turnover, eligibility versus rank-cutoff transitions where observable, realized holding counts, concentration, return/drawdown, cost, reversal and capacity proxies.
authority: Finite research only. No tracked strategy, funding, monitoring, broker, approval or live-setting change. Expanded-pool validation remains a separate qualified-parent study; this does not reopen the rejected expanded-FR25 arm.
